subject: Logic
title: What Is a Decision?
description: Learn What Is a Decision? in one minute.

hook.text: You chose to read this. That choice had alternatives, costs, and consequences—even if you didn't notice them.

buildup.text: A decision is selecting one option from a set of alternatives, each with different possible outcomes.

discovery.text: Decision theory studies how rational agents should choose—and how real humans actually do.

twist.text: Not deciding is also a decision. Delay, avoidance, and inaction all carry their own consequences.

climax.text: Every decision has three parts: options available, outcomes possible, and how much you value each outcome.

punchline.text: Choose or the world chooses for you.

quiz.question: What are the three parts of every decision?
